name: Vengeance (Combat)
body:
You are so focused on hurting your enemy that you ignore everyone else.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Favored Enemy Class feature.

Benefit: When using Power Attack against your favored enemy, you deal a +4 bonus to damage with your first attack in a round, but you suffer a -2 penalty to armor class for 1 round.

Normal: You get a +2 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against your favored enemy.

Special: Bonus damage from Vengeance stacks with bonus damage from Power Attack and favored enemy.
